scientific_integrity: All-width proof uses integer quotient-cell boundaries, published chessboard connectivity, and elementary surface classification. Widths 3 through 8 checked by exact Smith normal form; finite checks not treated as proof for unbounded width.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the C3 action on three rows; does not classify full n>=5 homotopy type. Indexed originality is provisional, with a modern full text inaccessible and possible unindexed parallels.
title: Sharp three-torsion transition in cyclic three-row chessboard quotients
